observations: Photo 0 shows the front panel of an orange generator with the brand name 'SANDING' and 'ChongQing SanDing General Power Machine Co., Ltd' visible on a label.
The label also includes 'POWERED BY SANDING' and Chinese characters '三鼎工业' (SanDing Industrial).
Photo 1 shows the control panel of the generator with model number 'SD8500E' clearly visible.
The control panel includes switches for engine start/stop, voltage regulator, circuit breaker, and AC 220V outlets.
The generator frame is heavily rusted and shows significant wear and tear.
Photo 2 shows a sticker with various certification marks including CE, GS, TÜV, e-mark, CSA, CARB, and a USA certification logo.
The sticker is labeled 'INTERNATIONAL STANDARD ORGANIZATION' at the top, which is not the official name of ISO.
The generator appears to be an open-frame, portable type, likely gasoline-powered, with a visible muffler and engine components below the control panel.

claims.claim: A Generator endorsed for Ruggedity & Strength by the International Standard Organisation
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a sticker labeled 'INTERNATIONAL STANDARD ORGANIZATION' with various certification marks, but this is not the official name of ISO. The sticker includes CE, GS, TÜV, etc., which are certifications, but there is no direct evidence of endorsement for 'Ruggedity & Strength' by any organization.

risks.risk: Generator may not be functional due to visible rust and wear
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the generator starting and running, with sound and voltage output measured.

risks.risk: Engine or electrical components may be damaged or worn out
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the engine, carburetor, spark plug, and wiring harness, or a video of the engine running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown mechanical condition

risks.risk: Fuel system may be clogged or degraded due to age or storage
risks.proof: Photo of the fuel tank and filter, or a video showing fuel flow and engine response to fuel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown fuel system condition

proof_requests: Video of the generator starting and running, showing voltage output.
Close-up photos of the engine, carburetor, spark plug, and fuel system.
Photo of the fuel tank and filter, if accessible.
response.reason: The generator's model and brand are identifiable, but its functional condition is unknown due to visible rust and wear. The seller's claim about ISO endorsement is unverified. Proof of operation and condition is needed before pricing.
